messages:
Maya (Billing): FYI gateway flagged Cliply (acct_CLP77) for duplicate refunds and auto-paused payouts. event evt_clp_3344.
Eli (Risk): How many refunds and over what window? Any matching original_charge ids?
Maya (Billing): Four refunds in 45m. Two share the same charge ch_z12x and identical $250 amounts. Refund ids: re_a1, re_a2, re_b3, re_c4. Snippet: {id: re_a1, amount: 25000, metadata: {batch: clip_batch_0326}}
chargeback-bot: Alert: refund_velocity_threshold breached (4 refunds / 45m). Risk score: 77%. Recommend hold and evidence collection. :warning:
Jordan (FinOps): Hold payout confirmed. If merchant confirms accidental duplicate, FinOps can provisionally reverse duplicates up to $500. Need merchant affidavit and matching logs.
Keiko (Support): Reached out to merchant rep (ops@cliply.io) asking for refund job logs and signed attestation. Asked them to include which refunds were manual vs automated.
Eli (Risk): Action items: 1) Pull gateway webhook delivery logs; 2) Compare merchant refund CSV to gateway events; 3) Prepare dispute response template if cardholders file.
Maya (Billing): Uploaded current evidence to /shared/finance/cliply/1917023344 and added portal note: "Paused: duplicate refund flag".
Jordan (FinOps): Noted. Keep ledger entries untouched until validation. If merchant provides clear duplicate proof, we process reversal for duplicates only.
Keiko (Support): Merchant replied: "We accidentally retried the refund job twice due to a cron failure. attaching logs and signed note." They attached logs to shared folder.
Eli (Risk): I'll validate logs and return disposition within 3 hours. If anything looks off, escalate to Legal.
Maya (Billing): Thanks team, will update thread after Eli's review.
